senses.gloss: गह्वरेष्ठ॑ a. being in the depth or in the secret.

गाह् गा॑हते (गा॑ह˚ति) pp. गाढ॑ (q.v.) dive or enter
into (acc.). — अति emerge from, overcome (acc.). अभि penetrate
into (acc.). अव or व plunge or enter into, be absorbed in (loc. or
acc.). उद् emerge, rise. उप enter. प्र penetrate, pervade. वि
dive into, bathe in, enter, penetrate (acc. or loc.);
 get, attain
(acc.);
 w. कक्षाम् be equal to (gen.). — Cf. अवगाढ, उद्गाढ,
परिगाढ, प्रगाढ, वगाढ, विगाढ.
